leads.claim: The Air Materiel Command notes the lack of physical evidence in the form of crash-recovered exhibits to prove the existence of flying discs.
leads.why: The document explicitly discusses the absence of recovered crash material as a key factor in their inability to confirm the nature of the objects.
leads.quote: The lack of physical evidence in the shape of crash recovered exhibits which would undeniably prove the existence of these objects.

doc_verdict: The document explicitly states that there is a lack of physical evidence or crash-recovered exhibits, confirming that the command possessed no such material at the time.
